verdict.rationale: Agents get short-lived JWTs minted from Dev Dashboard client credentials with a 60-minute TTL. The docs reference scope-gated access: `get_order` requires the `read_global_api_orders` scope, and `complete_checkout` works only when the token is granted purchase permission. Tiered identification (Token / Signed / Anonymous) also limits which tools an agent can reach, and AP2 frames agent action within pre-defined, verifiable boundaries. The evidence never shows how a user picks or narrows scopes when issuing a credential, or how to revoke or rotate one, so least-privilege issuance is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: documented scope catalog and self-serve scope selection at credential issuance, revocation/rotation controls, hands-on verification of minting a scoped token.
